purpose: Allow the supervisor to dispatch only pre-registered execution adapters. Delegations select executor_id; they never carry arbitrary commands or workflow paths.

LOCAL-REGISTERED-SCRIPT-001.side_effect_policy: Only the registered script's declared owner-lane effects are permitted.

GITHUB-REGISTERED-WORKFLOW-001.dispatch_reconciliation: Persist dispatch_id before API call; after ambiguous response search run metadata for the same immutable dispatch identity before redispatch.

A01-REGISTERED-QUALIFICATION-001.entrypoint_policy: qualification_id MUST EXIST IN CURRENT A01 REGISTRY

global_rules: A blocked or absent executor keeps a delegation CANDIDATE, never falsely READY.
Executor registration grants mechanics only, not product ownership or higher-gate authority.
Every mutation-capable executor validates the current fencing token before effect and before terminal acknowledgement.
External dispatch APIs are treated as at-least-once/ambiguous unless the provider explicitly supplies an idempotency guarantee for the exact operation.
GitHub cron is a backup observation/alert trigger, not the primary supervisor clock.
